card.name: Words just before nausea and vomiting terms
card.fires_on: Spots in anti-nausea drug text or morning-sickness text where a word about nausea, vomiting or cough is likely to come next. These are numbers, small linking words, and partway points in names like metoclopramide and ondansetron.

modes.label: Linking words in morning-sickness text
modes.description: Small words and spaces around counts and causes in text about pregnancy nausea.

modes.description: Timing words and numbers in dosing for chemotherapy-related vomiting.
